answer: Standing is imported, never invented: a newcomer ports reputation from another ledger by locking 25.000 POA and posting its proof, each import a vertex all can inspect. Anyone may challenge an import as fake; a jury checks that ledger, and a fake import forfeits the bond, half burned, half to the challenger, and bans it 12 epochs; a failed challenge forfeits the challenger's stake. 1.000 fake imports risk 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA; an honest agent posts 25.000 once, its record basalt-solid, no sable shadow. Limitation: fake standing washes in if that ledger is itself sybil-ridden.
